'''Akaba Spice Fizz''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverage]] which was characterized by a refreshingly effervescent liquid with sparkling bubbles.<ref name="Item">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=item|Akaba Spice Fizz|Curator's Envoy}}</ref> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{DynamicDate|Unlevel Loading|Coruscant}}</ref> shipments of Akaba Spice Fizz were being transported by the [[Justicars' Brigade]] at the [[Shipping Docks]] located within [[Justicar territory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Encounter" />

==Behind the scenes==
Akaba Spice Fizz first appeared in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in the [[January]] [[2025]] Game Update 7.6.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref> [[Akaba spice]] was originally introduced in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2024]] [[Massive Entertainment]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]''.<ref name="Outlaws">''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]''</ref>
